title: The Sacred Ephemeris
logline: When a novice navigator discovers an academy's sacred pulsar charts hide lethal drift, the abbess sends an armed cutter to silence the graduation flight.

roles.description: Guides novice jump-pilots through sacred stellar hymns; fiercely protective of the order's infallibility.
A brilliant astral cartographer whose telescope sweeps revealed that holy jump corridors have drifted into debris.
A heavily shielded escort vessel emblazoned with monastic sigils and intercept railguns.
A vaulted monastery station perched on the high rim of a pulsar radiation shadow.
An ancient navigation repeater anchored in the magnetic wash of the system's dead pulsar.
The religious order that certifies jump coordinates for all civilian pilgrim vessels.

public_situation: Novices at {system}'s monastery observatory prepare for their solitary leap into the pulsar corridor under ancient liturgical navigation rites.
private_truth: The abbess knows the pulsar's magnetic shift has turned the holy jump lane into an asteroid graveyard, but suppresses the data to protect church dogma.

beats.public_change: The monastery chapter sounds ceremonial bells across station comms to mark the graduation vigil.

missions.reason: The novice hires an unaligned pilot to scan the pulsar beacon's timing drift and verify whether the sacred jump corridor is still clear.
missions.private_fact: The novice discovered three pilgrim hulks smashed along the holy vector that church records claimed arrived safely.

beats.public_change: The abbess orders an emergency radio blackout across the observatory ring, citing liturgical impurity.

missions.reason: The novice asks the pilot to sneak the verified telemetry core into the abbey reliquary before the graduation flight launches.
missions.private_fact: The novice's own sibling is piloting the lead graduation skiff scheduled to jump at sunrise.

beats.public_change: An armed monastic cutter moves to intercept approaching civilian vessels outside the abbey perimeter.

missions.reason: The novice begs the pilot to disable the cutter before it seizes the reliquary and burns the telemetry logs.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain hails mid-fight, offering a trove of church scrip and relics if the pilot surrenders the core and departs.

beats.public_change: The graduation bells begin their final toll as the novice skiffs warm their jump drives in the launch bay.

missions.reason: The novice asks the pilot to deliver emergency abort codes directly to the launch bay control terminal before the skiffs jump.
missions.private_fact: The monastery abbess has locked the launch bay controls from the central high altar.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the launch bay controls with the telemetry proving the sacred route is lethal. The abbess offers a permanent church tithe to stay silent.

options.label: Broadcast the drift logs to halt the flights and shatter the sacred dogma
Accept the church tithe and let the abbess reroute the flights in secret
Broker a compromise allowing the novice to establish an empirical cartography wing

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the abort codes and exposes the navigational drift.
resolutions.summary: {role:monastic_chapter} halts the graduation flights and updates the sacred charts, while {role:abbess_preceptor} is stripped of her preceptor veil.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a holy star order was sending novices into an asteroid trap.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the cutter captain's bribe or conceals the drift.
resolutions.summary: The graduation skiffs take an unrecorded detour while {role:abbess_preceptor} preserves the order's infallibility behind quiet donations.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise allowing the novice to lead a new cartography wing.
resolutions.summary: {role:doubting_novice} establishes a secular cartography school, splitting {role:monastic_chapter} between traditionalists and reformers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the contract or the abort delivery fails.
resolutions.summary: The novice skiffs jump into the uncorrected drift; wreckage litters the pulsar rim while {role:abbess_preceptor} declares them holy martyrs.

loose_threads.detail: Monastery bullion receipts show large quarterly payments sent to a salvage cartel specializing in outer belt recovery.
A commemorative brass plaque honoring past navigation instructors had four names scrubbed out with an arc torch.

radio_hooks: Bells toll at {system}'s monastery spire for the annual Novice Jump Vigil.
Pilgrim captains query navigational drift following pulsar magnetic storm.
{role:monastic_chapter} reaffirms canonical jump coordinates as divinely ordained.

voice_direction.abbess_preceptor: Regal, melodic, speaking in liturgical cadences with absolute serene conviction that brooks no dispute.
voice_direction.doubting_novice: Hushed, urgent, speaking with the terrified precision of an astronomer watching an unavoidable collision.
